data.title: Customs seize 1k Apple phones
data.description: TAK: Customs officers have seized 1,000 second-hand Apple phones worth more than 7 million baht suspected of being smuggled into Myanmar.

data.description: Malaysian fighter Rifdean Masdor has apologised over a recent social media statement, while his management has sought to clarify its role in his preparations for ONE Samurai 4.

data.title: 'To the shelter, quickly!' Air raids reshape Kyiv school life
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - When the air raid alert sounded over the Kyiv region, children knew exactly what to do: they grabbed their tiny backpacks and ran towards the shelter, abandoning bikes, toys and even a doll on the school playground.

data.title: Aussie job scam hits Thais
data.description: Victims of an alleged Australian job scam have filed a complaint with the Anti-Trafficking in Persons Division, seeking an urgent investigation into losses exceeding 10 million baht.

data.title: The 1 Central Group unveils megatrends shaping Asian retail at World Retail Lab Asia 2026
data.description: The 1 Central Group, Thailand’s No. 1 digital lifestyle and loyalty platform and one of Asia’s top five,participated in the opening panel discussion of World Retail Lab Asia 2026 in Hong Kong. Kawin Tangudtaisak, President of The 1 Central Group, shared perspectives from Thailand and Southeast Asia, highlighting four key megatrends expected to shape Asia’s retail landscape toward 2030. His insights emphasised a shift from sales-driven growth toward delivering meaningful customer value, leveraging technology strategically and building enduring customer relationships. His participation further strengthened The 1 Central Group’s international presence, following its participation in the World Retail Congress in Berlin, Germany.

data.title: 'Leave us alone!' DC golfers fear worst over Trump's course remodel
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - For years, Max Salas has enjoyed teeing off at Washington's East Potomac Golf Links, a public course nestled in the heart of the US capital where ordinary Americans can enjoy a round without breaking the bank.

data.title: PSG late show downs Barca in Champions League, Liverpool fight back
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Holders Paris Saint-Germain made it three wins from three in this season's Champions League, beating Barcelona 4-2 thanks to late goals from Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz on Tuesday, while Liverpool clinched a dramatic comeback victory over Villarreal.

data.title: Regulator has 'power' to force Man City sale
data.description: LONDON - English football's Independent Regulator (IFR) will have "absolute power" to force Manchester City’s owners to sell if they are ultimately found to have run the club improperly, the watchdog’s chair has said.

data.title: Musk backs SpaceX-Tesla merger as rocket firm turns profit
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk said Tuesday he would back a merger of SpaceX and Tesla, as his rocket and AI company reported its first quarterly profit since going public, driven by deals to rent out computing power to AI firms.

data.title: KTC third-quarter profit climbs 8.9% to THB2.13bn despite weak demand
data.description: KTC’s third-quarter profit rose 8.9% to THB2.13 billion as lower funding costs and resilient asset quality offset weak consumer spending.

data.description: Fans of Japanese anime scores will have a chance to experience the powerful voice behind one of Attack On Titan's most memorable ending themes when singer-songwriter Ai Higuchi makes her Thai concert debut on Friday.

data.title: Wild Brian: The game's eccentric was a howling success
data.description: I was sitting at the back of the packed Bournemouth cinema with my girlfriend watching a comedy and enjoying the cozy romantic situation until a large gentleman sat directly behind us. Then during every funny scene he let out a very loud haunting, and slightly disturbing howl of a laugh. Not only did his horrifying laugh freak out my girlfriend, but also disturbed the entire back half of the cinema. When the film finished I turned to see the familiar big frame of Brian Barnes, who was totally oblivious to ruining everybody's evening entertainment.

data.title: Meditative visions
data.description: Since childhood, Hiroka Limviphuvadh, a Thai-Japanese artist and designer, has had a passion for art. However, because her parents were concerned about her pursuing an art career, she decided to earn a Bachelor's degree in General Management at Assumption University and later a Master's degree in Design Research, Integrated Design, from Kobe Design University in Japan.

data.description: Port have extended the contract of captain Peeradol Chamrasamee by two years, with the midfielder's current deal due to expire at the end of this season.

data.title: Europe unrest spurs warning
data.description: Thai embassies in Europe have warned Thai nationals to remain vigilant amid planned protests linked to the cost of living, employment and education, urging them to avoid high-risk areas and monitor local advisories.
